name: Marginloom synthetic support handling

labelMeaning.frustrated: author-assigned repeated or unresolved request requiring follow-up, not inferred emotion
labelMeaning.urgent: author-assigned active operational interruption needing immediate handling

limitations: Synthetic author labels do not establish performance on real customer messages.
Lexical baseline cannot reliably understand negation or quoted context.
Disjoint template groups still share a hand-authored generation distribution.
Calibration and test metrics can worsen under distribution shift.
No artificial logit sharpening; temperature may be below one.
Threshold exploration on test data is descriptive, not an unbiased release guarantee.

metricConventions.ece: top-label ECE; 10 equal-width bins; [lower, upper), last includes 1; weighted by count
metricConventions.brier: mean sum of squared class errors; range [0,2] for all class counts
metricConventions.auroc: macro one-vs-rest on probabilities; null if any class has no positives or negatives
metricConventions.disagreement: Jensen-Shannon entropy gap across raw member probabilities, in nats
metricConventions.policy: review if confidence < threshold OR novelty > threshold OR disagreement > threshold; missing extra signals do not trigger
metricConventions.riskCoverage: confidence-only ranking, complete tied groups; zero coverage risk null; separate multi-signal operating point
